title: 5 day PPL
author: Josh Prince
desc:
Very simple for Beginners to Advanced Lifters.
This programme aims to hit every muscle twice for optimal growth with the weekend to recover.
Aiming for 3 sets 12 reps with, ideally, 3 minutes rest between sets, you want to make sure the 3rd set of each exercise is absolute failure so that rest matters if you want to push it. You want to really struggle for that 12th rep on the 3rd. Half reps count! 

A lot of thought and planning went into this, I would love feedback and how to improve.

ex.note: Set bench to between 30° and 45° (closer to 30° the better, closer to 45° if there's some shoulder discomfort)
(Only 2 sets)Go as low as you can, hold it for 1 second, push hard up and straight back down slowly, repeat.
Open up as wide as you can, hold it, then slowly squeeze up and straight back down slowly.
Set the cable to the top. Step back and lean forward, press down and fully reach dowm, come back up slowly and the elbow bend as far as it can then explode down.
Use a wide handle, keep elbows pinned forward, brace leg against machine and lean over, fully extend on the press, let it slowly come down as far as you can
Set cable to just below wrist height to keep tension throughout movement, fully reach out and hold it and the slowly back down, don't let it come to a stop.
Set bench to a slight incline, not upright. Let arms hang down and out but tense, don't let arms go limp. Reach up and out infront of you, hold it then slowly back down and straight back up
Slowly let the weight go up and feel the stretch in lats, then drive down aiming to put your elbows in your pockets and have the bar touch your upper chest, hold it there then slow release.
Keep shoulders pinned low and place feet low to give clearance. Reach forward as far as you can with your elbows, pull back but keep it as low as you can don't let elbows go past hips.
45° bench, don't let arms go limp throughout each set. Slowly lower down and out and slowly back up, start to lower right before you get to the top end

Set cable head height so it makes a clean diagonal line for the rear delt from top to bottom. Keep chest up and arms straight as possible and reach open and out and stretch your arms right behind you.
*NOT SINGLE ARM* set bench up the same way and use the double rope, slowly follow and reach up with elbows to feel the lat stretch and then pull elbows back to waist as you sit up and squeeze it back
Set cable to shoulder height, grab handle and step forward letting the arm stretch back and up, keep elbow up and then curl and fully squeeze forearm to bicep. Slow release back and repeat.
Set cable to just below head height. Underhand grip rope attachment. Pull straight to your face and rotate shoulders back and squeeze like a double bicep pose, then slow release and repeat.

Hold the bar with a wide grip, think about making a straight line from your traps to your wrists and then just shrug. Don't involve legs and don't pull the bar up. Just shrug, slow up, hold, slow down
Keep elbows pinned by the waist, squeeze the dumbell as hard as you can and slowly bring it up and back down without letting tension drop, don't let the weight hang by your side
Always have a safety catch or spotter. Go low slowly and explode up

Keep legs straight, push bum out, and lower the bar as close to your shins as possible. Just before it taps the floor, stand straight up and puff chest out and shoulders back and then back down slowly
Set foot slightly low so it activates the quads, slow down, explode up and straight back to a slow down
Squeeze all the way in and release slowly, right before you get to the stop go straight for the next curl
Slow and controlled for each rep, try and bring your heel as close to under your bum as possible
Keep your feet quite close together and just move the weight with your toes and ankles, keeping full tension throughout
Same as the other, use double rope.
